crossRefs.note: He who walks blamelessly walks surely, but he who perverts his ways will be found out.
When the whirlwind passes, the wicked is no more; but the righteous stand firm forever.
The integrity of the upright shall guide them, but the perverseness of the treacherous shall destroy them.
Let integrity and uprightness preserve me, for I wait for you.
But as for me, I will walk in my integrity. Redeem me, and be merciful to me.

Better is the poor who walks in his integrity, than he who is perverse in his ways, and he is rich.

translations.web: Whoever walks blamelessly is kept safe; but one with perverse ways will fall suddenly.
translations.bsb: He who walks with integrity will be kept safe, but whoever is perverse in his ways will suddenly fall.
translations.kjv: Whoso walketh uprightly shall be saved: but he that is perverse in his ways shall fall at once.
translations.asv: Whoso walketh uprightly shall be delivered; But he that is perverse in his ways shall fall at once.
